decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-08-10 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Despite the draft Bill prepared to introduce a new Bill to replace the Immigrants and Emigrants Act, No.20 of 1948 having been presented to Parliament, it has not been possible to proceed with the said Bill due to the dissolution of the Ninth Parliament on 2024-09-24. Thereafter, approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-08-18 to draft a new Bill, taking also into account the decision given by the Supreme Court in relation to the said Bill. Similarly, approval has also been given at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025-12-10 to incorporate appropriate provisions in the said new Bill to designate the Secretary to the Ministry in charge of the subject of Immigration and Emigration as the Country Signing Certification Authority that implement the method of inserting biometric data into the chip of the epassport to be issued in the future. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to publish the Immigration Bill prepared by the Legal Draftsman, incorporating those provisions as well, in the Government Gazette and submit the same thereafter to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
